$note: 福德宮（2026-10-12）：福德通則。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 福德宮 p.560–575。弱智、自閉、心理不正常、變態、好色、淫濫、偽善、小器、鄙吝一類標籤不用；疾病、婚姻刑克、嫖賭飲吹不用；天姚、天刑、天月、華蓋、龍池鳳閣等引擎冇嘅星不用；要分日夜生、廟陷嘅條文暫不用。

rules.text: 火星在福德宮，你的精神比較浮躁，難以安定下來。
rules.en: With Huo Xing in your Wellbeing Palace, your mind tends to be restless and hard to settle.

source.quote: 火星及铃星入[福德宫]各主精神浮躁不安

rules.text: 鈴星在福德宮，你內心容易焦慮，常暗自擔心。
rules.en: With Ling Xing in your Wellbeing Palace, you are prone to inner anxiety and quiet worry.

rules.text: 擎羊在福德宮，你一生多勞，事情常落在自己身上。
rules.en: With Qing Yang in your Wellbeing Palace, you take on a great deal, and things often land on you.

rules.text: 陀羅在福德宮，你多憂慮，心事容易反覆纏繞。
rules.en: With Tuo Luo in your Wellbeing Palace, you worry a lot, and concerns tend to circle back.

rules.text: ｛地空地劫｝在福德宮，有時令你思想獨特，未必不吉。
rules.en: ｛Di Kong or Di Jie｝ in the Wellbeing Palace can mean an original mind, which is not necessarily a bad thing.

rules.text: 祿存在福德宮，你雖然欠衝勁，卻安樂。
rules.en: Lu Cun in the Wellbeing Palace: not much drive, but contentment.

rules.text: ｛天魁或天鉞｝在福德宮，你身邊有人照顧你。
rules.en: With ｛Tian Kui or Tian Yue｝ in your Wellbeing Palace, there are people around who look after you.

rules.text: ｛文昌文曲｝在福德宮，是福德宮最喜歡的星，令你聰明有才智。
rules.en: The Wellbeing Palace welcomes ｛Wen Chang or Wen Qu｝ above all other stars, a sign of intelligence and talent.
